name: Memorial sites of the Genocide: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi and Bisesero
description: Four memorials across Rwanda honour the victims of the 1994 genocide, in which an estimated one million people were killed in about three months. Nyamata's church and Murambi's technical school were sites of mass killings. Kigali's Gisozi hill holds the graves of over 250,000 people, and Bisesero recalls villagers who resisted for more than two months. Nyamata's church now holds the remains of 50,000 people.
